title: Rehabilitation Measures for Young Sex Offenders to Prevent Recidivism
what_it_is: Rehabilitation Measures for Young Sex Offenders to Prevent Recidivism

sections.label: Sex offender programmes and probation
sections.summary: Sex offenders in prison or on probation are assessed and given programmes, with MSF working with probationers and families on intervention plans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Regardless of age, sex offenders in prison or on probation will be assessed on their criminogenic risks and needs and undergo suitable programmes to reduce their risk of re-offending.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Prison Service (SPS) runs a psychology-based programme to help sex offenders better manage their interpersonal relationships and emotions and address their negative sexual attitudes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: At the end of the programme, offenders are guided to develop individualised relapse prevention plans.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Where the Courts have ordered probation, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) will work with probationers and their families to develop intervention plans, including treatment programmes.

sections.label: Youth treatment and prevention efforts
sections.summary: MSF research found youths receiving appropriate treatment have low re-offending likelihood, while SPS, SPF run interventions and prevention talks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: MSF's research has found that for youths who are at a developmental phase of sensation-seeking and impulsivity, their likelihood of re-offending is low when they receive appropriate treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, SPS has applied findings from a needs analysis of local sex offenders to enhance psychological interventions for them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Singapore Police Force (SPF) conducts crime prevention talks on sexual offences in schools and advises universities on security measures and conducts joint patrols with campus security.

sections.label: Sentencing differences and case circumstances
sections.summary: Sentencing differences may result from individual cases and specific circumstances that merit different punishment or treatment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: The differences in sentencing could be a result of individual cases and there may be specific circumstances in a case that merit a different punishment or treatment.
